chatterie.description: The chapter of The Cattery that is played outside Discord.

portail.lienMortAide: Portal links expire quickly and work only once — that is what makes them safe. Go back to Discord and reopen your cattery's panel to get a fresh one.
portail.fermeAide: You only get in through a link received on Discord. Open your cattery's panel over there: the portal is waiting, or it will tell you when it opens.

rideau.perduAide: Your session expired, or the cattery went back to Discord. Reopen the panel there — nothing is lost, production carried on without you.
rideau.recolteAide: You come home with the harvest: a golden kibble and a tripled purr for the next half hour.
rideau.retourAide: The cattery returns to Discord. The portal stays open: you can come back and finish the night.

entete.sousTitre: on the other side of the portal

journal.arrivee: The portal closes behind you. The night is quiet.
journal.respec: All the kibble goes back into the bowl.

pied.sansDelai: no delay between two strokes here — the night is yours
